term.def: This is the danger a company faces when it depends heavily on one leader or expert. If that person leaves or is lost, the business can struggle to function.

prompt.prompt: List the top 5 risks my business faces if we depend too heavily on [one vendor, leader, or AI tool] for [critical function]. Suggest ways to reduce this dependency.

quiz.q: TechCrunch reports S&P is considering a credit downgrade for Nvidia over governance and key man risks.
quiz.why: This directly restates what TechCrunch reported about S&P's review of Nvidia's credit standing.

quiz.q: News On AIR reports that India, the U.S. and eight other nations signed a declaration to safeguard AI supply chains.
quiz.why: This matches the headline about ten nations agreeing to protect AI supply chains.

quiz.q: AI models always give the exact same answer to the same question every time.
quiz.why: Many AI tools include randomness by design, so the same question can produce slightly different answers.

quiz.q: AI tools generally improve when they are trained on larger amounts of relevant data.
quiz.why: More good quality data usually helps AI systems recognise patterns more accurately.

quiz.q: AI can fully replace human judgment in every business decision without any oversight.
quiz.why: AI can support decisions but lacks context, accountability and ethical judgment that humans provide.
